Parimere unit price comparison: pack sizes, discounts and budgets

Compare unit prices and purchase costs across different pack sizes and offers.

How do I compare two packs?

Enter each price, pack size and quantity using compatible units. For example, compare a 500 g pack costing 4 with a 750 g pack costing 5 in the same currency. Their unit prices are 8 and about 6.67 per kilogram before extra costs.



What affects the result?

Discounts, shipping, taxes, fees, waste and prepared yield can change the comparison. Choose the ranking and planning settings that match the purchase.



How is the starting currency selected?

The web app uses the browser region when supported and otherwise defaults to USD. You can change it. Saved comparisons keep their original currencies.



Are the web and mobile apps identical?

No. The mobile app supports manually entered prices and exchange rates, saved comparisons and reviewed file import/export. Receipt scanning, household sync and automatic exchange rates are not implemented in the current React Native mobile version.



Where is information stored?

Calculations run locally. Web household sharing is optional and requires a configured server. Shared files leave the app only when you choose to share them.
